title: Full Body Push/Pull
author: Chris V.
desc: A bit of a hidden gem of a split that hardly anyone talks about, this program combines some of the advantages of Upper/Lower splits and Full Body splits. There is plenty of time to recover from sessions and you get to train some of your favorite muscles in each session and you never have to do another full leg workout again!
